europe.headline: Europe's latest close found was Thursday, with tech and financials leading losses.
europe.detail: The STOXX 600 -0.38% at 654.87, the DAX -0.43% at 26,325.01 and the FTSE 100 -0.43% at 10,782.66, as concerns over tighter US regulation of artificial intelligence weighed on technology and financial shares. No later close was found.

latam.headline: Mexico's IPC hit a six-month high after a surprise Banxico rate cut.
latam.detail: The S&P/BMV IPC closed at 71,033 +0.30% on Thursday, while the dollar (USD/MXN) +0.73% at 18.76 pesos. No later Latin America report was found.

mideast.headline: Oil fell sharply on the week on US-Iran peace-talk hopes, with Gulf supply risk still a floor.
mideast.detail: Brent closed at $103.60 on Nov 3, its lowest since Oct 7, after settling at $104.77 on Nov 2, with WTI at $96.46 on Nov 2. Goldman Sachs raised its December Brent forecast to $105. Tanker attacks in the Gulf pushed prices back up later in the week.
